helpline_intro: If anything looks unfamiliar, we are here.
upload.title: Share your bank statement
upload.intro: When you feel ready, share your bank statement and we will read it for you. There is no hurry.
upload.choose_file_a11y: Choose a bank statement file to share
upload.bank_prompt: Which bank is this statement from?
upload.in_progress_a11y: Your statement is being shared. Please wait.
upload.processing_a11y: We are reading your statement now. This takes a few seconds.
upload.success.title: We have read your statement
upload.success.rows: We read {parsed} entries. {rejected} were set aside for a closer look.
upload.success.body: Thank you. There is nothing more you need to do right now.
upload.fallback.title: We will read it for you
upload.fallback.body: We could not read this file automatically, so someone from our team will read it for you within a day or two. You do not need to do anything more.
upload.fallback.reason_unsupported: This kind of file needs a person to read it.
upload.fallback.reason_unknown_bank: We are still learning to read this bank's statements.
upload.fallback.reason_parse_failed: Some of this statement needs a person to read it.
upload.fallback.reason_requested: We will read this for you.
upload.fallback.a11y: Our team will read your statement for you within one to two days.
upload.error.generic: We could not share your statement just now. Please try again in a little while.
upload.error.too_large: This file is larger than we can accept. Please share a smaller file.
upload.error.quarantined: We could not accept this file. Please share your statement again as a fresh file.
upload.error.unavailable: We could not process your statement just now. Please try again in a little while.
upload.resume.prompt: You have a statement you started sharing. Would you like to start again?
upload.resume_failed.title: We could not restore your upload
upload.resume_failed.body: That is alright. You can start again whenever you feel ready, or call us and we will help.
upload.resume_failed.a11y: Your paused upload could not be restored. You can start again or call the helpline.
